algorithm: MAPPO (human-regularized, CTDE, with hybrid advantage estimation)
hand: 11-DoF (6 actuated) dexterous hand, per side (vendor not stated)
arm: 7-DoF arm per side (M92C humanoid upper body)
success_criterion: proportion of objects that are successfully caught by the catcher and remain in hand until the end of the episode
headline_metric: Success Rate, training vs. unseen objects (Table III / Abstract)
headline_value: 99% success on training objects, 75% on unseen objects (sim only, N=1000 each)
human_data: a small number of human throwing demonstrations collected via teleoperation of the right arm in sim (exact count not stated)
note_gaps: Individual per-term reward formulas and the KL-regularized objective equation were rendered as images/inline math in the PDF and did not survive extraction as text; only term names, prose descriptions, and the combined weighted-sum equation (R = 4R_dist + 0.5R_obj + R_contact + 0.0001P_action + P_hand) are available.
